metadata.title: EOS MCP Surface Comprehensive Risk Register

risks.title: Hallucinated Security Assurance via Simulation Stubs
risks.cause: Tools return mock exit code 0 and pristine receipts without executing static analyzers or microVM containers.
risks.impact: Autonomous agents commit insecure code believing it was verified in a hardened sandbox.
risks.mitigation: Segregate simulation tools to lab environment and enforce real static analysis via quality-auditor.

risks.title: Cognitive Context Bloat & Planning Degradation
risks.cause: 74 tools consume ~25,000 characters (~6,500 tokens) in system prompts.
risks.impact: LLMs suffer from attention dispersion, erratic tool selection, and increased latency.
risks.mitigation: Prune agent-visible surface to 14 Canonical Tools, reducing token overhead by 73.8%.

risks.title: Dual State Machine Desynchronization
risks.cause: Two separate modules maintain mission lifecycle state (.missions/ filesystem vs EOSOrchestrator in-memory FSM).
risks.impact: Missions started in one system are invisible or untracked in the other.
risks.mitigation: Unify into a single canonical mission initialization pipeline.

risks.title: Evidence Hash Spoofing on Phase Transitions
risks.cause: Tool validates SHA-256 string format (64 hex) but does not verify that the physical EVD-XXXX.json file on disk has passing assertions.
risks.impact: An agent could pass random hex hashes to bypass phase gates.
risks.mitigation: Wire phase gate validator to look up physical evidence files and check exit code 0.

risks.title: Global FDIR Killswitch Inadvertent Tripping
risks.cause: Single tool call trips the entire control plane into safe-mode, halting all mutating operations.
risks.mitigation: Strictly gate with Authority Level A2 and explicit human justification.

risks.title: Advisory Write Barrier Evasion
risks.cause: Barrier check is a read-only query; agents writing outside MCP tools do not trigger physical OS blocks.
risks.impact: Unauthorized file creation in protected roots.
risks.mitigation: Wrap all file modifications in guardrail-sandwich middleware.

risks.title: Configuration Baseline Overwrite Risk
risks.cause: Overwrites .cursorrules, CONSTITUTION.md, and core governance files with baseline hashes.
risks.impact: Could overwrite legitimate authorized configuration changes if baselines are stale.
risks.mitigation: Require explicit baseline map verification and pre-backup snapshot before overwrite.

risks.title: Infinite TDD Repair Loop Resource Consumption
risks.cause: Spawns child processes in a loop when tests continuously fail.
risks.impact: High CPU usage and process starvation if tests hang.
risks.mitigation: Hard-cap maxIterations to 5 and enforce execution timeout per iteration.
